name: Md Nayon Reza
intro: A Microbiology graduate with over six years of professional experience in hospital-based clinical laboratory practice, beginning my career after completing a Diploma in Medical Technology. My professional background combines extensive hands-on experience in clinical diagnostics, clinical microbiology, and transfusion medicine with published research in red cell alloimmunization. Building on this blend of academic knowledge and practical expertise, I am keen to pursue postgraduate studies and research, with particular interests in  microbiology, clinical microbiology, Immunology, molecular biology, biotechnology and Molecular diagnostic.
